WITH ventas_regiones AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region,
        i.producto_id,
        SUM(i.cantidad) AS unidades,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.region ORDER BY SUM(i.cantidad) DESC) as rn
    FROM pedidos p
    JOIN clientes c ON p.cliente_id = c.cliente_id
    JOIN items i ON p.pedido_id = i.pedido_id
    WHERE p.estado = 'entregado'
      AND p.fecha >= '2025-01-01'
      AND p.fecha <= '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.region, i.producto_id
)
SELECT 
    region,
    producto_id,
    unidades
FROM ventas_regiones
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region;
